name: rails-sidekiq

platform.name: Unknown
platform.why: no platform manifest: the Dockerfile and compose.example.yml are for self-hosting on a machine or VPS, the publish workflow only pushes an image to a container registry, and bin/render-build.sh is a build script with no render.yaml beside it

processes.note: service web runs the image's CMD ./bin/rails server (Dockerfile); bin/docker-entrypoint runs rails db:prepare before the server starts
service worker: bundle exec sidekiq, queues in config/sidekiq.yml; sidekiq-cron inside it enqueues the jobs of config/schedule.yml

data.note: REDIS_URL for Sidekiq and Action Cable (config/cable.yml production adapter redis); an optional cache store on CACHE_REDIS_URL
Active Storage service defaults to local (storage/, config/storage.yml); compose mounts a volume on /rails/storage; S3 and R2 are the alternatives

idle.why: turbo_stream_from opens a Turbo Streams subscription over Action Cable for the account page; hidden until the rule read templates
turbo_stream_from @chat: a chat page subscribes to its stream over Action Cable

notBreaks.why: a vendored browser library pinned by importmap and served to the page; its setInterval runs in the visitor's browser

notes: Read Procfile.dev (development only, with a tailwind watcher), compose.example.yml, the Dockerfile and bin/docker-entrypoint, the workflows, config/*.yml, config/environments/production.rb, config/initializers, app/channels and a sweep of app/, lib/ and vendor/javascript for every rule pattern. Only one Ruby line matches a rule regex as written (queue_adapter = :sidekiq); the timer, the disk and the websockets are real but declared in YAML, an ENV.fetch default and ERB views. Migrations run in bin/docker-entrypoint before the server (db:prepare), not in a release step, so no release-migrations finding; on Cloud Run they would better become a job. lib/tasks/*.rake and perf.rake hold no rule pattern. The websocket finding is turbo_stream_from in the signed-in layout (also in app/views/chats/show.html.erb and app/components/UI/account_page.html.erb), carried by Action Cable on Redis; the timer is the three sidekiq-cron jobs of config/schedule.yml polled inside the Sidekiq process.

known.process missing: 1 x worker: the Sidekiq worker is a service on the project's own image with `command: bundle exec sidekiq` in compose.example.yml, beside a root Dockerfile; a compose file adds processes only when nothing else named any
